5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Instruction is used to de-energize either i. all the iTRAK movers and sections ii. all sections iii. all movers iv. individual sections or v. individual movers.
Instruction Execution: ----- Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1002 Device Handler is faulted. Clear faults to apply commands 1003 Device Handler is not in Available state. 1006 Overlapping energize and de-energize commands 1010 Cfg_TargetType out of bounds. Value must be set within -1 <= Cfg_CommandType <= 3 1011 Cfg_TargetID out of range, input must be value within -1 <= Cfg_TargetID < number of sections 1012 Cfg_TargetID out of range, input must be value within -1 <= Cfg_TargetID < number of movers 1050 Energize command timeout, verify track hardware state
Revision Notes: ----- 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 4.0 - Renamed Add-On Instruction. Support for iTRAK57xx Device Handler 4.0 1.1 - Event fields match Machine Builder standards order 1.0 - First Release
